bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 28020.1546 Released - This Canary Channel update includes general improvements and fixes for OneDrive and Dropbox issues.
Overwatch's Year-Long Narrative Arc - A new story-driven era begins with 'The Reign of Talon' in **Overwatch**.
Simplified Dev Environment Setup - **WinGet Configuration** allows developers to set up their machines with a single command.
Leadership Changes in Security - **Hayete Gallot** returns as EVP of Security, focusing on enhancing security and quality at **Microsoft**.
Enhanced Data Resiliency with Azure - **Azure NetApp Files** introduces Elastic zone-redundant service for improved data availability.
Detecting Backdoored Language Models - New research from **Microsoft** focuses on identifying backdoors in AI language models.
AI Security Practices Evolving - **Microsoft's SDL** adapts to address AI-specific security challenges in software development.
PostgreSQL on Azure for AI - **Azure** enhances **PostgreSQL** to support AI developers with improved performance and integration.
Infostealers Targeting macOS - New threats exploit macOS vulnerabilities using social engineering techniques to deliver malware.
Securing AI Application Supply Chains - **Microsoft** emphasizes the importance of securing AI frameworks and components.
